name: Jitma
title: Descendants of Ishmael
summary: Jitma is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah. He was the son of Ishma and belonged to the Edomite or Judean lineages listed in the genealogies of the Books of Chronicles. He is a lesser-known biblical figure with no major events associated with him beyond the genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jitma is mentioned as part of the genealogical records of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles. He appears in a list of descendants and family lines.
